title: General Agent Evaluation (Exgentic Open Agent Leaderboard)
read: partly (first 100k of 162k chars + targeted second chunk)
grade: M (peer-review status unverified; code/data released on HF)
finding: AppWorld(100 test_normal tasks): code-action Smolagent vs tool-calling ReAct vs ReAct-Short (tool shortlisting) vs 3 others x 5 models. Opus4.5: Smolagent .70, ReAct-Short .64, ReAct .61. Shortlisting AppWorld delta: Opus +3pp, Gemini3 +5, GPT5.2 +22 (ReAct=0.00 because of 128-tool API cap), DeepSeek -5, Kimi +1. Opus cost/task 5.75->3.78 with shortlisting. Failed runs cost 20-54% more. Wilson CIs +-7-13pp per cell
applicability: direct: only independent cross-architecture AppWorld comparison with cost; shortlisting = tool exposure
limitation: cost table is per-task average across ALL benchmarks, not AppWorld-only; caching not described; apparently single run per cell; shortlister model/k not stated; scaffolds are not the AppWorld reference agents; small open models near floor

title: TabAgent
finding: AppWorld w/ CUGA(GPT-5.4): learned classifier replaces LLM shortlister: -85-91% inference cost of the shortlist step, pass@1 29.2% vs 27.1% on 24 tasks x<=3 seeds, paired diff CI [-18.8,+16.7]; no no-shortlist baseline; shortlister call costs $0.052 with ~21k prompt
applicability: shows AppWorld shortlisting practice in an industrial agent and the power problem at n=24
limitation: cost saving is of the shortlist call only; not billed end-to-end; no caching mention; one agent

title: TheMCPCompany
finding: Tool exposure varied: browser / retrieval over 18,505 tools (~20 per task) / oracle set. Oracle best: e.g. GPT-5-mini 38.9% $0.17 vs retrieval 22.9% $0.26 vs browser 24.6% $0.41; cost computed from token usage x list price
applicability: closest published tool-exposure-by-cost design; includes gpt-5-mini
limitation: no mention of caching or runs/variance; retrieval-quality bottleneck confounds exposure

title: Token Reduction Is Not Cost Reduction
finding: 2,848 paired runs: -38.4% tool-output tokens gave +6.8% billed cost (CI +2.8,+11.3); cache read/creation ~80% of bill; cost model 1.25x write / 0.1x read
applicability: cached-pricing accounting method for bill study
limitation: coding agents in Claude Code, one provider; cache carryover not excluded
